description: The Monday weekly_summary push (part 7.d). One topic for every language, so English only. Rotated by ISO week number. {week} is the week that just ended, e.g. 42. Never names a player: display names are user-written and this goes to everyone.

templates.title: 🏆 Week {week} results are in!
templates.body: The weekly leaderboard is final. See where you ranked, then start climbing this week's board.

templates.title: 🏆 The Week {week} board is final
templates.body: Who topped the charts? Check your rank and grab a head start on the new week.

templates.title: 📊 Your weekly rank is ready
templates.body: Week {week} is done and dusted. See how you stacked up, and start fresh this week.

templates.title: 🥇 Week {week} champions crowned!
